title: Aptamer 1-step conjugation protocol
author: Jorge Fernandez Mendez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8h4ht8w
materials: Reconstitute the aptamers by pipetting 30 μL of 100 μM stock on an empty eppendorf tube. Place in a thermoblock at 95 ºC for 10 minutes. And move the tube quickly to an ice bath, letting them to cool down for 10 minutes more. The reconstituted aptamer can be kept at 4ºC for several weeks, or store freezed at -20 ºC for long periods.

Cover with aluminium foil or tape the eppendorf tube, and Incubate the prepared solution for 1h 30 minutes at room temperature with strong agitation. (250 rpm on a thermoblock agitator is recommended).

steps.title: Prepare sulfo‑NHS solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 44.5 mg sulfo‑NHS, dissolve in 500 µL distilled water to obtain a 0.4 M solution; store at 4 °C (stable for a few months).

steps.title: Prepare EDC solution
steps.instruction: Pipette 29.5 µL of 97 % EDC into 470.5 µL distilled water to make a 0.32 M solution; store at –20 °C and prepare fresh unless used within the next few days.

steps.title: Dilute and wash beads
steps.instruction: Combine 200 µL of 2.5 % wt bead stock with 300 µL MES buffer (final volume 500 µL); centrifuge at 15 000 rpm for 4 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend pellet in 500 µL MES buffer, using repeated pipetting to ensure complete dispersion. If aggregates appear, reduce centrifugation time or sonicate beads for 5 min at moderate power.

steps.title: Activate aptamer with crosslinkers
steps.instruction: In an Eppendorf tube mix 40 µL of the 0.4 M sulfo‑NHS solution, 40 µL of 5'‑amino‑terminal modified aptamer, and 40 µL of the 0.32 M EDC solution.

steps.title: Conjugate aptamer to beads
steps.instruction: Vortex the 500 µL bead suspension in MES for 20 seconds, then quickly add 160 µL of the activation mixture from the previous step and vortex briefly to mix.

steps.title: Wash conjugated beads
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 15 000 rpm for 4 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend pellet in 500 µL PBS‑T; repeat this washing cycle three total times.

steps.title: Quench remaining reactive groups
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 50 mM glycine solution to the beads and incubate for 10 min with agitation to block any unreacted crosslinkers.

steps.title: Final resuspension and storage
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in the desired buffer, preferably PBS‑T containing 0.05 % Tween‑20 for optimal dispersibility on nitrocellulose membranes; store conjugated beads at 4 °C for several weeks.
